notes: English/LTR Instagram-style app (MaterialApp title 'Instagram Clone', default blue Material theme, BottomNavyBar). The app-bar title is literally 'FlutterShare' at 50px; the code asks for fontFamily 'Signatra' which is not bundled (only Billabong is), so it falls back to the system font, drawn that way. Bottom-bar labels are the code's own ('Searsh' spelling kept). In the code the 2nd tab ('Searsh') opens the Activity Feed and the 4th ('Notification') opens user search, so those two were not chosen to avoid a label/content mismatch in the portfolio. Bundled assets are photos of real people, so avatars are initials and post photos are abstract illustrations; names, captions and counts are sample data.
